tex_content.html: \begin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch9:9-7Suppose $M$ is either the 2-sphere of radius $R$ or the hyperbolic plane of radius $R$ for some $R > 0$. Show that similar triangles in $M$ are congruent. More precisely, if $\gamma _1$ and $\gamma _2$ are geodesic triangles in $M$ such that corresponding side lengths are proportional and corresponding interior angles are equal, then there exists an isometry of $M$ taking $\gamma _1$ to $\gamma _2$. \end{exercise}
